Section 6(2) of the Sales Promotion Employees (Conditions of Service) Act, 1976 provides that the provisions of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, as in force for the time being, shall apply to sales promotion employees as they apply to workmen within the meaning of that Act. Justice Saurabh Shya
